capabilities: Provide Protomaps vector map tiles to Places
Load label fonts and icons the style names
disambiguation: Not a stand-alone maps plugin; it only supplies map data to the Places plugin.
extras: Requires network access: map tiles and styles load from the selected style source, glyphs and sprites from protomaps.github.io/basemaps-assets. No background tasks. README points to the Places sandbox for examples.
intentEvidence: Map provider for Places using Protomaps, with vector maps and POI discovery.
problem: Places needs a map data source, and this add-on supplies Protomaps vector tiles, styles, glyphs and sprites for it.

relations.evidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.
